findings.rule: Referenced note must exist on the drawing
findings.reasoning: The title block heat_treatment field specifies 'REF NOTE', but none of the provided notes (N2 through N8) contain any heat-treatment instruction. The required specification is entirely missing from the drawing.
findings.correction: Add a note defining the required heat treatment for C-45 material (e.g., hardness range, quench and temper parameters), or remove the 'REF NOTE' callout if no heat treatment is required.

findings.rule: Surface treatment must be compatible with the base material
findings.reasoning: I.Z.B.P. (Iron Zinc Bright Passivation) is a zinc electroplating process intended for steel. While C-45 is a carbon steel and can technically be plated, zinc plating is typically specified for low-carbon steels; for medium-carbon C-45 used in cylinder rod mounting applications, this finish may not provide adequate corrosion protection or wear resistance compared to more suitable treatments like hard chrome plating or black oxide.
findings.correction: Verify that I.Z.B.P. (trivalent) is the correct surface treatment for a C-45 cylinder rod mount, or specify a more appropriate finish such as hard chrome plating or phosphate-and-oil.

findings.rule: Tolerance should not be unnecessarily tighter than standard machining capability
findings.reasoning: Dimension D21 calls out 20±0.02 mm. The general machining tolerance for the 6–30 mm range is ±0.2 mm, making this ten times tighter than standard. A ±0.02 mm linear tolerance requires precision grinding or fine boring, adding cost without clear functional justification in the data provided.
findings.correction: Confirm whether ±0.02 mm is functionally necessary for feature F10; if not, relax the tolerance to match standard machining capability (e.g., ±0.1 or ±0.2).
